BACKGROUND: The hosted @llm-canon and @spine E2E tests play a fixed script, canon-journey.js scenePrompts[scene], one prompt per turn, cycling. A prompt only advances the story if the runtime matcher grants an authored reveal: matching uses storygame.runtime.candidate_matcher._matches_all(tuple(tuple(g) for g in item['action_evidence']), command) over entries in data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml whose id starts with 'k_sl_<scene lowercase>' and have action_evidence; an item is only eligible when its `requires` facts are established by earlier reveals (or the scene's entry state). The 1A, 1B, 2C, 3A, 3B prompts were already repaired this way and are the model: read tests/test_1b_spine_prompts.py and tests/test_3ab_spine_prompts.py and frontend/e2e/canon-journey.js first, and copy the test pattern exactly (parse the array from the JS source with a regex, assert string count, assert each prompt matches EXACTLY its intended reveal id set, assert the chain order is eligible by `requires`/`establishes`).
The 2026-10-15 hosted run stalled because today: 1C's four prompts match NOTHING; 2A prompts 1 and 3 match nothing (prompt 2 matches only k_sl_2a_b_r2); 2B prompts 2-4 match nothing (prompt 1 matches only k_sl_2b_a_r1). 3C prompts 4 and 5 match nothing.

TARGET CHAINS (verify every one with the real matcher before keeping it; word the prompts as imperative commands in the player's voice like the existing ones, never first person narration, see docs/player-input-guide.md; keep each prompt a single sentence a human would plausibly type; do NOT paste a bare evidence-word list):
1C (four prompts, in order): a_r1 (inspect the electrical load / ventilation / vents at the loading docks; establishes facility_proof) -> b_r1 (compare the identification numbers / uniforms of the people in the processing area against the missing-person records; requires facility_proof; establishes captives_confirmed_alive) -> c_r1 (read/access the logistics computer; requires facility_proof and captives_confirmed_alive) -> c_r2 (play the recording of Charles and Rebecca; same requires). Each prompt must match ONLY its target. Avoid wording that also matches k_sl_1c_a_r2, b_r2 (needs the name Michelle), etc.
2A (four prompts): a_r1 (search the servers / leaked documents at Brandon's hideout) -> b_r2 (build or present inspector credentials / forms; requires facility_infiltration_needed, which is already true on entry to 2A because it is the 1C->2A transition trigger; establishes false_identities_ready) -> e_r1 (go to / drive Brandon to the facility checkpoint and present the inspector credentials; requires false_identities_ready; establishes facility_perimeter_reached, which the pacing event scrutiny_2a in pacing.yaml needs) -> c_r1 (tell the supervisor about the cooling-water problem / unscheduled inspection; requires false_identities_ready and facility_perimeter_reached). Beware ties: a prompt must not match another 2A item (b_r1 'cooling system', c_r2 'enter the infrastructure corridor', etc.).
2B (four prompts): keep prompt 1 (a_r1) -> a_r2 (read my own record / file) -> b_r1 (read the JANUS development records / Brandon's records) -> c_r1 (inspect/read the corrupted prisoner files). Requires: janus_evidence from a_r1/a_r2. Each must match only its target.
3C: its entries have long evidence lists. Today prompts 1-3 match k_sl_3c_a_r1, k_sl_3c_b_r2, k_sl_3c_c_r1 (in that order, requires satisfied). Only if you can make prompts 4 and 5 each match exactly one intended 3C reveal whose `requires` facts are all established by the earlier prompts' reveals in order (check carefully: k_sl_3c_d_r1/d_r2 require captives_reaching_surface; find which reveal's establishes provides it and what other 3C facts could be missing), change them; otherwise LEAVE 3C UNTOUCHED, write no 3C test, and say so plainly in your notes. Never leave a 3C prompt that matches a reveal whose requires cannot be satisfied.

Each scene's array must stay a plain JSON-style list of double-quoted strings (the tests parse it with a regex). The frontend test frontend/e2e/canon-journey.test.js and tests/test_canon_journey.py must still pass.
